headline: Co-op fixes, persistent savestates and custom destinations proposed on develop
summary: Four pull requests open on develop, but no commits land on the branch. They propose co-op world fixes (#99), packaged editor layouts (#100), added ship destinations and cross-level imports (#101), and persistent Ratchet & Clank savestate support for an external mod (#102). The destination work is explicitly unfinished: its current implementation supports PAL only and manual gameplay testing has not been completed.
highlights: #99 addresses pause menus making objects disappear from another player's world and adds explicit object-death reporting.
#100 packages data-only object layouts so installed editor tools can apply typed edits without the decompilation's headers.
#102 proposes cross-launch savestates for the same game build and disc. Save-slot files and policy remain the external Project Save Clank mod's responsibility.
